reference.pathophysiology: Night pain with knee metaphyseal swelling in adolescents and Codman-sunburst spikes names osteosarcoma for Rosen neoadjuvant plus limb-salvage plans while diaphyseal onion-skinning with fever names Ewing for molecular biopsy with chemo-radio care; older pelvic rings with chemo resistance name chondrosarcoma for wide excision, and lytic lesions with Mirels nine-plus take prophylactic nailing.
